newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA TIGHTEN GRIP ON ASHES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA TIGHTEN GRIP ON ASHES.

text.p: England's faint hopes of regaining the Ashes all but disappeared on Thursday as Australia dominated the opening day of the penultimate test by rattling up 302 for three.
Trailing 2-1 in the six-match series, England needed victory at Trent Bridge but lost the toss for the fifth successive time and with it the chance to bat on the best pitch so far.
Openers Mark Taylor (76) and Matthew Elliott (69) put on 117 for the first wicket and Greg Blewett then weighed in with 50.
England's wicket-takers included 19 year-old Ben Hollioake, making his test debut along with his older brother Adam.
But it was Australia's Waugh brothers who finished the day in control, with Mark not out 60 and Steve unbeaten on 38.
